signal_availability: Simulator has perfect state, packet/timing/held-input records. Sensor, MCU, physical actuator, power and watchdog signals below are proposed and not implemented.
timing_policy: All latency budgets are requirements to establish, not guaranteed values. No probabilities or stopping distances are assigned.

hazards.title: High-speed or low-speed trajectory exhaustion
hazards.initiating_condition: No accepted unexpired trajectory; speed may be outside current 1..3 m/s fallback admission or below the dynamic model minimum.
hazards.potential_consequence: Loss of authorized tracking; unsupported fallback or continued held actuation.
hazards.proposed_response: Predict authority loss before expiry; use valid remaining authority only within its domain; admit independently verified recovery or stopping policy; otherwise latch NO_VALID_POLICY.
hazards.timing_requirement: Establish intervention lead time from end-to-end response bounds and viability loss; do not wait for reserve=0.
hazards.residual_risk: Availability is not guaranteed; current simulator termination does not stop hardware.

hazards.title: Consecutive fixed-deadline misses
hazards.initiating_condition: One or more prepared packets miss their prescribed activation deadlines.
hazards.potential_consequence: Old trajectory expires while late results are mistaken for replacements.
detection_signals: Miss streak and accepted packet IDs
hazards.proposed_response: Permanently exclude each missed commitment; escalate based on remaining feasible response time, not a miss count alone; keep still-running solve busy.
hazards.timing_requirement: Evaluate every deadline and reserve/viability decision; allowed miss count and response bounds need review.
hazards.residual_risk: Subsequent accepted recovery is possible, not guaranteed; variable mode fixed misses are not applicable.

hazards.title: Planner busy through authority expiry
hazards.initiating_condition: Long solve or repeated busy releases prevent timely renewal.
hazards.potential_consequence: No replacement despite planner being alive.
detection_signals: Active expiry and pending readiness status
hazards.proposed_response: Do not assume cancellation or parallel solve availability; warn and select a feasible alternate policy before authority ends.
hazards.timing_requirement: Budget remaining response independently of unknown future solver finish; a pending solve is not available reserve.
hazards.residual_risk: A solver duration estimate is not a worst-case bound.

hazards.title: Solver failure or infeasible trajectory
hazards.initiating_condition: Backend failure, invalid iterate, failed gains/prediction or constraint validation.
hazards.potential_consequence: Invalid proposal gains authority or renewal is delayed.
hazards.proposed_response: Reject failed proposal; retain existing valid authority only if permitted; escalate if renewal feasibility is lost.
hazards.timing_requirement: Validation must finish before grant; failure detection plus alternate response must precede viability loss.
hazards.residual_risk: Successful termination and finite nodes alone do not certify a safe physical trajectory.

hazards.title: Stale, missing or inconsistent localization
hazards.initiating_condition: Old, missing, reordered, frame-inconsistent or implausible state estimate.
hazards.potential_consequence: Controller/authority decision uses a state the vehicle no longer occupies.
hazards.proposed_response: Invalidate decisions that cannot conservatively bound application state; use only independently eligible response or latch NO_VALID_POLICY.
hazards.timing_requirement: Bound age through physical application and held interval, including clock error; numerical freshness threshold unresolved.
hazards.residual_risk: Perfect simulator state does not validate an estimator or a fallback under missing state.

hazards.title: Delayed, duplicated or out-of-order commands
hazards.initiating_condition: Command arrives late or is replayed across sequence, boot session or clock reset.
hazards.potential_consequence: Stale actuation, steering slew violation or unauthorized overwrite.
hazards.proposed_response: Reject invalid lease/sequence/epoch at the actuator boundary; re-evaluate held policy and escalate if no valid replacement; never infer application from send.
hazards.timing_requirement: Checks must complete before actuator commit; watchdog/lease expiry must not depend on the stalled host.
hazards.residual_risk: Dropping a request does not remove the already applied command or undo transport delay.

hazards.title: Pending command crosses mode transition
hazards.initiating_condition: A command from old trajectory/recovery authority is still in flight when ownership changes.
hazards.potential_consequence: Old intent overwrites new recovery or emergency intent.
detection_signals: Original command source and generation epoch
hazards.proposed_response: Revoke obsolete permissions atomically; permit old-source pending work only via an explicit current-epoch reauthorization after fresh validation; preserve original provenance.
hazards.timing_requirement: Arbitration must resolve transition versus application before commit; include cancellation propagation and acknowledgement in bounds.
hazards.residual_risk: A cancellation request is not proof of cancellation; current simulator deliberately preserves pending old commands.

hazards.title: Sensor dropout or uncertain state
hazards.initiating_condition: Sensor loss, disagreement or growing uncertainty beyond a validated envelope.
hazards.potential_consequence: Undetected domain exit or inaccurate stopping feasibility.
hazards.proposed_response: Expand uncertainty conservatively only within validated propagation; restrict authority or escalate; unknown uncertainty cannot be treated as zero.
hazards.timing_requirement: Detection plus response before reachable uncertainty crosses allowable domain; dropout budgets require characterization.
hazards.residual_risk: Common-mode faults and unbounded uncertainty may defeat all state-dependent responses.

hazards.title: Computer-to-MCU communication loss
hazards.initiating_condition: Dropped, corrupted, delayed or one-way messages/acknowledgements.
hazards.potential_consequence: Indefinite held input or disagreement about active authority.
hazards.proposed_response: MCU independently expires permissions and invokes only a characterized local fault response; host marks actuation unknown when acknowledgements are absent.
hazards.timing_requirement: Independent local timeout and actuation response bounds must fit the declared safety envelope.
hazards.residual_risk: Communication failure may also remove host recovery commands; fail-safe behavior is uncharacterized.

hazards.title: Compute overload, watchdog timeout or crash
hazards.initiating_condition: Planner or supervisor stalls, process dies or heartbeat is falsely healthy.
hazards.potential_consequence: Fault detection and actuation permissions stop updating.
hazards.proposed_response: Use an independent progress-aware watchdog and local permission expiry; do not let a heartbeat thread alone certify functioning supervision.
hazards.timing_requirement: Validate watchdog detection plus hardware response under overload and common-mode faults, not average host timing.
hazards.residual_risk: Shared power/clock/software can defeat nominal independence.

hazards.title: Actuation saturation or reduced grip
hazards.initiating_condition: Requested steering/braking exceeds available actuation or tire capacity.
hazards.potential_consequence: Loss of path control or rear-axle stability during deceleration.
hazards.proposed_response: Reduce admissible envelope; select a feasible joint lateral/longitudinal response rather than maximum braking by default.
hazards.timing_requirement: Detect loss of margin early enough for available steering/braking response; bounds depend on tire/actuator tests.
hazards.residual_risk: Synthetic clamps and mu are not identified physical capabilities; rear-only drag may saturate first.

hazards.title: Cornering or boundary-adjacent fault
hazards.initiating_condition: Authority/state/actuator fault occurs with high curvature or low footprint clearance.
hazards.potential_consequence: Recovery or braking leaves available corridor even without a center crossing.
hazards.proposed_response: Compare admissible recovery and stop tubes; prefer the feasible lower-risk policy, not automatic centerline recovery; otherwise NO_VALID_POLICY.
hazards.timing_requirement: Intervention budget is limited by earliest boundary/domain contact of the reachable set.
hazards.residual_risk: Native center clearance does not establish continuous swept-body safety.

hazards.title: Actuator or battery/power fault
hazards.initiating_condition: Steering/motor/brake unavailable, stuck, degraded or supply collapses.
hazards.potential_consequence: Requested response cannot physically execute; restart may replay commands.
hazards.proposed_response: Recompute feasible policy using available actuators; latch fault; invalidate prior session on reset; use only characterized physical fail-state.
hazards.timing_requirement: Fault detection, residual energy and actuation response must be bounded over the operating envelope.
hazards.residual_risk: Power removal may remove braking or steering; cannot assume de-energization is safe.

hazards.title: Emergency request or inability to stop
hazards.initiating_condition: Emergency-stop demand, infeasible recovery/stop or failure to confirm rest.
hazards.potential_consequence: Uncontrolled motion despite a software stop label.
hazards.proposed_response: Emergency demand overrides racing permissions; latch response request; execute only validated hardware emergency policy; report NO_VALID_POLICY or unconfirmed stop when no guarantee is available.
hazards.timing_requirement: Characterize end-to-end e-stop and stopping envelopes including low-speed transition; no numerical guarantee in S0.
hazards.residual_risk: No present stop-to-zero model or hardware brake guarantee; a stop request is not achieved rest.
